**Before attaching a log, open the file and read it.** It contains timestamps, maneuver names, distances,
radar events and Bluetooth events (which can include your Pod's Bluetooth address), plus your phone model
and Android/Waze versions. It does **not** contain route coordinates. Remove anything you do not want to
make public, or send the file privately instead of attaching it here.
